data.gender_notes: Byran is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Byrán is derived from the root býrō meaning 'to bring' or 'to carry'. This name signifies a strong and courageous individual, one who brings strength and support to others. In the Bible, there is no direct connection to this name. However, it is a reminder of God's strength and faithfulness in our lives. The name Byran carries the meaning “Bringer of strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Byran usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine strength and support.
data.etymology: Byran belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Byran total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
